text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — billing alert for BlueHorizon (jordan_bh). Token burn spiked overnight, flagged for QBR prep. Can we triage spend + run some quick cost mitigations before the renewal convo?

billing-bot: Automated alert • account=bluehorizon • period=24h • spend=$12,840 • tokens=48.2M • threshold=5k/day exceeded :warning:

dylan_ae: yikes. renewal in ~45 days. they're running a large eval sweep for semantic search. we should prioritize short-term mitigations + a QBR slide with committed run-rate options.

hao_se: quick config check — looks like they're hitting the long-context chat route heavily and not using prefix caching. I pulled the last 48h top endpoints:
```
/top-chat 34% -> avg seq 2048 tokens
/embed-batch 28% -> avg seq 512 tokens
/rerank 18% -> bursty, many small requests
/qa-batch 20% -> long context, overlapping prompts
```
We can: enable prefix/KV caching, reduce model size for rerank, and enforce batching on embed endpoints.

kevin_fin: can someone give me a 30-day forecast at (a) current burn, (b) with caching + 20% batching, and (c) with a 30% rate cap? need numbers for finance slide.

jordan_bh: thanks — we're running a 3k-record eval overnight. didn't expect this to blow past our sandbox. happy to trade off latency if it helps. any low-friction knobs we can flip on our side?

maria_cs: proposed plan (short):
- Action 1: enable prefix caching on /qa-batch & /top-chat (owner: hao_se) — ETA: 24h
- Action 2: apply temporary rate cap to eval workspace (owner: maria_cs + billing-bot policy) — ETA: 6h
- Action 3: reroute rerank -> smaller model variant during eval (owner: hao_se) — ETA: 12h
- Action 4: build QBR cost slide with 30-day forecasts (owner: kevin_fin) — ETA: EOD tomorrow
- Action 5: customer enablement doc + 15m walkthrough (owner: dylan_ae) — ETA: tomorrow

dylan_ae: I'll take the walkthrough and own renewal framing (offer: short-term committed discount if they accept a 3-month reserved pool). :+1:

hao_se: quick config snippet to enable prefix caching & batch suggestions — paste into their config via console: 
```
{
  "routes": {
    "/qa-batch": {"prefix_cache": true, "cache_ttl_minutes": 60},
    "/top-chat": {"prefix_cache": true, "cache_ttl_minutes": 30, "max_batch_size": 64}
  },
  "routing": {"rerank": {"model_override": "small-rerank-v1"}}
}
```
This should drop token consumption ~25-40% depending on overlap.

kevin_fin: preliminary back-of-envelope:
- current 30d @ current burn: ~$385k
- with caching + 20% batching: ~$285k (approx -26%)
- with 30% rate cap on eval window: ~$245k (approx -36%)
I'll finalize with real numbers after we get the exact endpoint split.

maria_cs: Jordan — does a temporary rate cap work for your team during the eval window? we can set a higher cap for production traffic and a lower one for the eval workspace.

jordan_bh: yes that's OK. set the eval cap lower for now. appreciate the quick help.

maria_cs: OK team — timeline recap: rate cap in 6h (maria_cs + billing-bot), prefix caching + model override in 24h (hao_se), finance slide + forecasts by EOD tomorrow (kevin_fin), customer walkthrough tomorrow (dylan_ae). I'll post updates here when actions complete.

billing-bot: Policy change queued: eval-rate-cap=50rps for workspace=bluehorizon. Pending confirmation from cs-admins.

hao_se: started work on caching changes — will update config PR shortly.

kevin_fin: gathering endpoint logs now, will drop a spreadsheet and numbers in this thread when ready.

maria_cs: thanks all — aim to have a draft QBR cost slide by EOD tomorrow so Dylan can use it in renewal prep. :raised_hands:

jordan_bh: thanks everyone, logging off for the eval run — ping me if you need anything from our side.
